[b][u]Announcement From the Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/u][/b]

The government of President Fereydun Khan of Dhornaper condemns Oceanice's support for the colonial state of Mizrahel. Increased military presence in support of Mizrahel is not conducive towards a stable and prosperous Shamat.

Mizrahel's oppression of indigenous Shamatine peoples and aggressive stance towards other Shamatine states has demonstrated, without question, that Shamat will not experience stability and prosperity for as long as Shamat does not rid itself of Mizrahel specifically and colonialism generally.

Dhornaper will discuss Oceanice's unhelpful and unwarranted intervention, in support of a state that does not respect Oceanice or consider its interests, with our partners in the SSP. We do not find Oceanice's attempt at deterrence to be effective and it will not affect our actions regarding Mizrahel.

Signed,
Jalayer Khan, Minister of Foreign Affairs

As of today, the ULR has released a statement upon the request of the USO to allow Oceanice military aircraft inside of Lavian airspace, and for them to refuel at Lavian airfields. Coming in the wake of the Moreman Act, the response from the President Achebes press office reads as follows:

We have been requested to allow what some would call a new friend to use our military infrastructure for transport. While this would normally be a simple request, the reasons behind it are ghastly and deplorable. This request looks to move warplanes to a foreign state, potentially increasing tension in the region drastically and setting up the foundation for a conflict. 

We cannot approve this request without violating our national security, interests, or integrity. We do not wish to see another war in West Shamat, let alone one driven by religious divides with the potential to become a drawn out conflict.

[spoiler=Establishment of Pirabad-Baladullah diplomatic relations and cooperation][quote=pirabad;61215317]PirabadTo His Excellency Abdoul Mahonomayi,
Minister of Foreign Affairs
Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah,

On behalf of the people and government of Pirabad, I extend my sincere appreciation for your warm message and for the gracious hospitality extended to our observer delegation. We are grateful for your willingness to cover all expenses and for the spirit of brotherhood and cooperation reflected in your words.

We wish the people of Baladullah peace, stability, and success in the upcoming elections, and we pray that the process brings prosperity and unity to your nation. Our convoy will include the Minister of Agriculture and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Pirabad, who will be honored to observe the elections and, if your schedule permits, engage in discussions with the appropriate representatives of your government.

In this regard, we would welcome the opportunity to explore the establishment of formal diplomatic representation. Pirabad is prepared to offer the opening of an embassy of the Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah in Shanbe, the capital of Pirabad, as a step toward deepening diplomatic, economic, and cultural cooperation between our two Muslim-majority nations. We believe such a move would greatly strengthen ties within the Ummah and lay the foundation for long-term partnership.

We thank you once again for your hospitality, goodwill, and readiness to support Pirabad during its period of rebuilding. May Allah guide our nations toward cooperation, stability, and shared prosperity.

With highest respect,
Amir-ali Attari
President
Republic of Pirabad[/quote]

[b]Office of the Sultan[/b]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]
As salaamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. We are willing and able to extend our hosting of your delegation for 5 days, that we may discuss the establishment of embassies, a fair trade and investment treaty, and cooperation in the economic, security, and cultural fields, in shaa Allah. Those meeting with your high level delegates would be myself, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, the Minister of Religious Affairs, and the Minister of Trade. May this lead to a strong relationship between our countries, in shaa Allah.

[i]Masud al-Ayyubi

[spoiler=Rejection and Condemnation of USO Decision to Send Troops to the Mizionist Entity]

[b]ATK[/b]

[i]بسم الله العزيز الحكيم[/i]

The Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah strongly condemns the recent decision by USO to send troops to Mizrahel, which is an imposed colonial entity occupying indigenous Shamatine land. Sending tens of thousands of troops and other kinds of military equipment and forces will dangerously increase tensions on West Shamat, and can only be seen as a veiled threat to the stability and sovereignty of the rest of West Shamat. As such, we also refuse any sort of military or economic cooperation with USO unless they withdraw their forces and military support to Mizrahel. Colonialism of any kind is unacceptable, whether or not those colonists are open about it or hide it behind revisionist history and religious claims.
